hypotheses.name: Magnetic/gravity edge-migration consistency across upward-continuation heights
hypotheses.layers_and_signature: Competition TMI/magnetic and isostatic-gravity fields; trace signed lateral movement of matched gradient ridges across several upward-continuation heights using NaN-safe padding and edge taper.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: A dipping density/susceptibility boundary can persist beneath cover or without a mapped Quaternary surface rupture.
hypotheses.difference: Tests the trajectory of an edge with continuation height, unlike static cross-scale edge agreement (H28-1) or SI-assumption-dependent Euler source-depth estimates.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: highest qualitative information potential; unmeasured, no numeric projection
hypotheses.availability: competition bands conceptually; cached stack/template absent in this checkout; restore/hash-verify before use

hypotheses.name: Paired signed cross-scarp change points in elevation and radiometry
hypotheses.layers_and_signature: DEM elevation plus GeoDAWN radiometric K/Th or U/Th; detrend regional signals and test consistently oriented paired flank change points along strike.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Aligned relief and material asymmetry may reveal subtle or degraded scarps with weak individual elevation contrast.
hypotheses.difference: Joint signed flank-change statistic, not generic structural-step features or radiometric ridge co-location; cross-repository novelty not established.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contact, alluvial-fan boundary, paleoshoreline, road or earthwork.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: moderate qualitative potential; unmeasured, no numeric projection
hypotheses.availability: official landing page named; source host unavailable in this sandbox; local radiometric layers absent; not viable until bytes/coverage/metadata verified

hypotheses.name: Basin-scale drainage-divide asymmetry reversals aligned with an independent magnetic edge
hypotheses.layers_and_signature: Conditioned DEM plus magnetic-edge candidates; multi-basin divide asymmetry/direction reversals along corridor, with basin-scale validation.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Distributed tilting around a concealed normal fault can perturb basin/drainage geometry without a crisp scarp.
hypotheses.difference: Basin-scale network response rather than local terrain descriptors; refines previously proposed, unimplemented H38-4 drainage work, not globally novel.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lithology-controlled erosion, stream capture, or climate/base-level changes.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: moderate but highly uncertain; unmeasured, no numeric projection
hypotheses.availability: official USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM catalog named; exact in-footprint tile availability/bytes not checked; tiles absent, not viable yet

hypotheses.name: Depth-coherent lateral MT conductance-boundary migration plus gravity
hypotheses.layers_and_signature: USGS multi-depth MT conductance slices plus gravity; trace lateral boundary migration across depth slices with independent gravity-edge corroboration.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: A concealed fluid-bearing or altered structure may produce a coherent conductive boundary beneath cover without a surface trace.
hypotheses.difference: Depth-dependent boundary trajectory, unlike single-depth conductance × dilatation or proposed pipe-alignment tests; verify queued H38-3 and other-site code first.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Clay-rich sedimentary basin margin or lithologic conductor.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: low-to-moderate qualitative potential; unmeasured, no numeric projection
hypotheses.availability: official USGS DOI named; exact item/bytes/coverage not verified obtainable in this session; not viable yet
